subject: Post-demo: context depth, token mix & draft pricing commitment
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@nimble-retail.com>, Tom Rojas <tom.rojas@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: context depth, token mix & draft pricing commitment

Thanks again for your time earlier, Elena and Tom — great session. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before Marcus and product ops scope a pilot: 

Key takeaways from the demo:
- Primary use case: customer-facing product QA assistant and long-form order summarization for enterprise accounts.
- Typical prompt length: short prompts for retrieval + 2–3 contextual system messages (avg prompt tokens ~220).
- Target completion: mostly mid-length summaries and conversational replies (avg completion tokens ~780).
- Expected per-user monthly usage: ~15–30 completions, bursty during campaign windows.
- Context depth needs: majority fit comfortably in 8k window, but ~10% of requests will require 32k (multi-document summaries + full order histories).

Draft costing assumptions we discussed:
- Baseline unit economics estimate (ballpark): $/1M tokens target range you mentioned during the call: $700–$1,100.
- Pilot ask: confirm whether you want us to price to a committed 1M token bucket or a monthly per-token estimate for the pilot.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm the monthly token budget range you want to evaluate for the pilot (e.g., 5M, 10M, 25M).
2) I will circulate a short mutual action plan that reflects the 32k use-case for a subset of flows and a trial commitment tier with discounted unit price.
3) Marcus will propose SLA/latency targets for the pilot if you confirm target regions.

Attachments: demo recording, sample prompt set we used (attached).

If you want a quick sketch of how different token mixes map to monthly spend at various $/1M targets, I can send that in a follow-up — or attach a spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0194

From: Elena Morris <elena@nimble-retail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rojas <tom.rojas@nimble-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context depth, token mix & draft pricing commitment

Thanks Vanessa — that recap is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Monthly budget: for an initial pilot with a subset of enterprise accounts, we're comfortable starting at a 10M token/month committed tier. If the pilot shows <2x cost-per-conversion than our current rules engine, we can expand.
- Token mix: confirm that the 10% 32k estimate is for the heaviest flows only; most traffic will be 8k or less.
- Target $/1M: we'd like to see options at $900 and $650 per 1M for different commitment/term lengths.

Also, two operational asks: whether Redwood can preserve KV cache across short-lived sessions for our summary flows (helps reduce prompt tokens), and the expected latency SLO for 8k vs 32k requests.

Tom will share a few sample order histories (anonymized) so you can profile actual tokenization.

Cheers,
Elena
Head of Product, Nimble Retail
elena@nimble-retail.com

---
[inline: Tom Rojas attached brief note with sample files]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@nimble-retail.com>, Tom Rojas <tom.rojas@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 17:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context depth, token mix & draft pricing commitment

Appreciate the clarity — helped craft two concrete pricing options for the pilot (attached PDF). Quick answers inline: 

- 10M/month commitment works well for a 4–8 week pilot. We can do an exploratory pilot at that size with two discount bands: 1) 6-month minimum term at $900/1M tokens, 2) 12-month minimum term at $650/1M tokens (includes committed capacity, reserved GPU headroom during peaks).
- 32k at ~10% of total traffic: we'll route those to a higher-memory pool and bill at the same unit price but track usage per-context bucket; for very heavy 128k needs we'd propose a separate premium tier (none expected in this pilot).
- KV/prefix caching: yes — Redwood preserves KV cache per user session for up to 48 hours by default in Dedicated/Private plans; for hosted we can negotiate a session-preservation SLA for the pilot. That will materially reduce avg prompt tokens for your multi-step summaries.
- Latency SLO: target P95
  - 8k requests: 180–250ms token streaming latency for completions in our standard profile (depending on batch sizing).
  - 32k requests: 600–1200ms (higher variance due to multi-chunking).

Action items: 
A) Marcus will put together a brief SLA + rollout plan (I included him on this thread).
B) Tom/Elena to share anonymized order histories and a 2-week sample of request timestamps.
C) I'll run a token-profile using your sample docs and send a cost sheet mapping three scenarios: conservative, expected, and aggressive (5M/10M/25M monthly).

Attaching: redwood-pricing-draft-v1.pdf (numbers + discount bands).

If Elena and Tom are good with the 10M anchor, I'll prepare a mutual action plan and a draft pilot MSA that reflects the pricing band you pick.

Best,
Vanessa

---
[attachment: redwood-pricing-draft-v1.pdf]

From: Tom Rojas <tom.rojas@nimble-retail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Elena Morris <elena@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 14:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context depth, token mix & draft pricing commitment

Vanessa — thanks for the fast turnaround. Quick confirmation from our end after reviewing the draft: 

- We agree to move forward with a 10M/month pilot anchor. Prefer the 6-month term at $900/1M to start (faster procurement cycles on our side).
- We'll send the anonymized 2-week request slice and 50 sample order histories by EOD Monday. Expect a few long order histories that may push past 32k (we'll flag those).
- Please include a short estimate in the MAP for projected monthly spend at the $900/1M band across the conservative/expected/aggressive scenarios.

Next steps: Vanessa to circulate MAP + pilot MSA draft; Marcus to confirm SLA targets and perf runbook.

Thanks — Tom
Senior Engineering Manager, Data & Insights
tom.rojas@nimble-retail.com
